_doc: Exotics Racing LVMS (2015-2021, target A) through the Lake Murray chain (tools/ship_track.sh; Kevin 2026-10-28: 'rebuild all four with the Lake Murray chain'). The draft is the engine's own off the georeferenced NAIP trace (source.type aerial: aerial -> elev -> project -> mesh), then the underlay drops data/track.obj into loop.blend as GEN_* collections (scripts/blender/underlay.py). Authoring happens in that blend (AUTH_*), the prep / exporter / spawn builder run from airoso's scripts/ac, the four gates run on the BUILT kn5. The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso.
_owed: First pass = the draft through the chain, no authoring yet. Kevin's dressing call (DOSSIER, 2026-10-28): as in 2013 — the two smaller buildings on the south-west corner, no Welcome Center; the Mojave ground in place of the default grass. The T2 bank (-6.0 deg from the lidar, mirror_x flips the sign) is in the draft already via road_profile.
